pull_request.title: Software: add repeatable ACTS tracker crossing profiles in the 3 T field
pull_request.head: codex/tracker-sensitive-propagation
pull_request.body:
Run the current DES-025 DD4hep Tracker through its native ACTS TrackingGeometry in a generated DES-026 3 T finite-winding field map at fixed **pT 1, 10 and 100 GeV**. Retain zero-inclusive nSensitives-versus-eta profiles for the full tracker, pixel/short-strip/long-strip groups and all seven DD4hep systems, rendered with the pinned unrooted environment as SVG/PDF/PNG and interactive HTML.

The reusable workflow is `make tracker-propagation`, with separate `tracker-propagation-controls` and `tracker-propagation-plot` targets. Saved compressed counts can regenerate plots without ACTS. Configuration, seeds, source/runtime hashes, native accounting and numerical diagnostics are retained in [the report](docs/validation/tracker-propagation/README.md). Follow-up to merged #96 and issue #95; no detector geometry changes.

Validation:
- All **24,576 nominal probes** have complete unique generated/native identities, requested pT, origin vertices, source-matched seven-system counts and outer World-portal exits. Conversion matches **45,646 native sensitive planes in 117 volumes**.
- All 33 ROOT TProfiles agree with unrooted branch profiles and independent bin sums, including zero crossings. Separate PhysVal reproduced the native accounting and profiles at `5181bd317e6b369388805e1567d695a22a4e33aa`.
- Half-step controls change no counts in 512 paired probes per momentum. The finer map changes **7/512 (1.37%)** of the 1 GeV probes by one crossing at finite sensor edges; 10/100 GeV controls are unchanged. These differences remain explicit: per-track map convergence and precision acceptance are not established.
- An end-to-end Make replay with 2,048 probes per momentum reproduces every saved CSV field exactly and regenerates byte-identical field-map data.
- Eight new accounting/profile controls, six tracker controls, twelve solenoid controls, 33 session tests, 28 project-record tests and ten token-site tests passed; records validate and the token preview builds.

This is a prototype sensitive-plane crossing characterization, with material effects off. The supported-node runtime and its development-binary provenance are documented; no tracking-efficiency or engineering-approval claim is made.

![Tracker crossing profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/asalzburger/nodd/7675d4b2cd40692664aa4ae5fe10aaebb0fdab58/docs/validation/tracker-propagation/sensitive-crossings.png)

events.text: Tracker sensitive-crossing profiles in the 3T field — see the canonical narrative for outcomes and checks.

No files were written and no runtime test completed. The ACTS environment verification command waited on escalation approval for about 36 minutes, then was aborted; implementation never resumed before your pause.

Confirmed native source findings:

- Text map loader: `.txt`, whitespace `r z Br Bz`, r fastest, `firstQuadrant=False`, explicit mm/T units.
- `PropagationAlgorithm` silently drops failed propagations; ROOT writers renumber survivors. One probe per event preserves stable `(event_nr, 0)` and supports missing-event rejection.
- Both propagation ROOT writers include event/track IDs plus eta, phi, pT, p and initial parameters.
- Steps store all six GeometryIdentifier fields, sufficient for exact reconstruction and source-system mapping.
- `SimParticleContainer` supports typed `ReadDataHandle`, iteration, particle ID, direction, position, charge and momentum. A Python recorder can preserve actual generated probes in one table.
- Native configuration exposes `sterileLogger=False`, `energyLoss=False`, `multipleScattering=False`, `maxStepSize`; EigenStepper + Navigator follows the existing propagation example.
- Preflight reported stale setup/lockfile fingerprints and unavailable recorded full DD4hep/Geant4 sources.

Input revision read: `fbf81c4c72469c1bda0cd6122f9912af6f17228d`. Ownership is suspended; I will make no further writes.

TRKPROP-SoftEng-02 reviewed `b78f754dc15eaa408492aae3e50e8e9fed0ce443`. No source files changed.

Findings:

1. **P1 — plotting environment lost:** `tools/tracker_propagation/run.py:74,85` resolves the virtualenv Python symlink, bypassing its installed packages. Coordinator has reported remediation to `.absolute()`; that fix is outside this pinned review.

2. **P2 — replot accepts failed, stale or mixed samples:** `tools/tracker_propagation/plot.py:102–119` checks CSV contents but never reads case `run.json`, its status, configuration or artifact hashes. A synthetic case with valid smoke counts and `status=FAIL` reached ROOT output creation. Require PASS, verify the counts hash, compare case configuration against the study, and require common field/geometry identities before plotting. Also invalidate prior PASS evidence when a native rerun starts.

Actual checks:

- All **5 pure unit controls passed** using `software/build/unrooted-venv/bin/python -I -B`.
- Independently inspected the 128-probe smoke ROOT outputs: complete unique expected event identities in generated particles, summaries and steps; all 128 source-system sums equal native `nSensitives`; requested 1 GeV pT verified.
- All six smoke artifact hashes match recorded accounting.
- Zero-crossing denominator and profile mean/error controls passed.

Core identity matching, 64-bit source mapping and profile accounting look sound within these checks. No native runtime activation or full-study validation was performed.

events.text:
TRKPROP-PhysVal-01 completed. Reviewed **`7b02e7eb88196d1dd0282e32a12a3d7b3db4dc5a`**, read-only. No files changed, installs, native ACTS execution or further delegation.

The definition is scientifically suitable for a **prototype geometry-crossing characterization**: generated muons from the origin, fixed **pT** of 1/10/100 GeV, uniform generated η/φ, both charges, and material effects off. It supports statements about sensitive-plane crossings; it does not establish hit efficiency, reconstructed measurements or tracking performance.

| Requirement | Observable/evidence | Assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Current DD4hep tracker | Native DD4hep-backed ACTS sensitive elements | DES-025:23–29 requires retaining each pixel chip and both strip faces. Final native conversion evidence pending. |
| Subdetector/full split | Systems 1–3 pixel, 4–5 short strip, 6–7 long strip; full 1–7 | `plot.py:15–27` agrees with DES-025 and retained tracker translation. Eventwise sum closure is implemented. |
| True profile | Unweighted mean crossings per generated η bin, including zeros | `plot.py:59–75` stores the required TProfile sufficient statistics correctly. |
| Profile errors | Population standard error, `sqrt(M2/N²)` | Independently verified in memory through ROOT serialization and both unrooted readers. |
| Current 3 T field model | Finite uniform-J annular vacuum winding | Field-sheet construction is consistent with the retained DES-026 model. It remains a vacuum prototype without installed iron or conductor qualification. |
| Complete generated population | Every unique generated probe, including zero crossings and failed propagations | Not established by the committed CSV validation; correction required below. |

**Findings**

1. **P2 — Completeness and kinematics checks are insufficient.**  
   `plot.py:34–56,96–103` checks row count, finiteness, η bounds and count closure, but permits duplicate track identities, wrong pT, invalid charge and invalid φ. I demonstrated that two identical `(event_nr=0, track_nr=0)` rows with `pt_GeV=999` and `charge=0` pass for `expected=2`. Such checks cannot substantiate the report’s “all tracks” claim or exclude survivor bias. Require the expected unique identity set, correct track number, requested pT, charge ±1 and φ range; retain per-probe propagation status and account explicitly for failures. Confirm pT from initial momentum components, rather than trusting its CSV label.

2. **P2 — Declared field normalization can diverge silently from executed normalization.**  
   `field_map.py:81–91` obtains the actual central field from retained sizing, while `study.json` independently declares `field.central_field_T`. The latter is currently 3 T and agrees, but is not enforced. Reject a mismatch to preserve the repeatable configuration contract.

3. **Qualification — Report numerical checks as sampled checks.**  
   `field_map.py:116–130` evaluates interpolation error at 149 selected points and refinement on a subset. The report’s `maximum_interpolation_error_T` is their **sample maximum**, not a bound over the complete map. Validation covers approximately `r≤1201 mm, |z|≤4001 mm`; the map extends to 1300/4200 mm. Establish the actual propagation/query domain and avoid claiming whole-map accuracy from those samples.

**Verified field evidence**

The supplementary, uncommitted `build/tracker-propagation/field/field-report.json` matches the pinned field script SHA and all four pinned source hashes. Its map hash also matches the actual text map:

- Field-script SHA: `b9c58532ce6c74e87f7bda313e78cb824adf53688a9c398a9243e924fbf8bce3`
- Map SHA: `67ae45d833fbf5e47cf31ff30fd586bdb1ad87eea0ba86c5a3ba7fe9ccc1d1e3`

events.text:
**TRKPROP-PhysVal-02 completed at `5181bd317e6b369388805e1567d695a22a4e33aa`.** No remaining scientific blocker was found for the requested **prototype overview**, provided the existing numerical and performance qualifications remain. This is a technical assessment, not human design approval.

The prior P2 findings are corrected:

- `plot.py:45–53,87–141` now enforces complete unique probe identities, valid charge/φ, requested pT, paired directions and consistent executed geometry/field/runtime. The earlier duplicate-probe adversarial fixture is rejected.
- `counts.py:90–142` checks generated particles against native summaries and steps, including origin, muon identity, momentum components, charge, source-mapped counts, world exits and map support.
- `field_map.py:83–85` rejects requested normalization inconsistent with DES-026.

I independently checked the retained compressed counts and all supplementary nominal ROOT files after verifying their SHA-256 hashes against the committed manifests:

- All **24,576 nominal probes** have complete expected identities, origin vertices and the requested transverse momentum.
- Every final native step is on the outer World portal within 0.001 mm.
- All seven source-system counts exactly reproduce native `nSensitives` and retained CSV rows; no repeated sensitive IDs were found.
- Maximum recorded coordinates are `r=1111.327393 mm`, `|z|=4001 mm`. Adding the configured 50 mm step margin remains within the 1300/4200 mm field support.
- All **33 profiles** reproduce independently from retained counts: means agree exactly; maximum standard-error discrepancy is `1.95×10⁻¹⁵`. Actual ROOT TProfiles and unrooted branch profiles also agree.
- Each nominal η bin contains **79–131 probes**. Zero-crossing probes in subsystem profiles remain included.

The seven refined-map changes are supported by the evidence. I independently recovered events **4, 48, 167, 259, 356, 398 and 421**, each changing exactly one crossing in pixel endcap systems 2/3 or short-strip endcap system 5. There are four gains and three losses. Their approximate local clearances change sign, and the native crossing-side positions are inside the finite sensitive bounds. Common-surface position shifts reproduce the retained **0.029–0.066 mm** range. These observations support the stated finite-edge interpretation.

They also establish that **per-track map convergence has not been demonstrated**. The retained `DIFFERENCES_REQUIRE_REVIEW` status and README:72–83 qualification are appropriate. The sampled interpolation discrepancy improves from **0.305 mT to 0.061 mT**, but that does not bound crossing-count errors at discontinuous sensor edges.

One optional clarification would strengthen the report: state **7/512 = 1.37% changed probes**, alongside the signed mean change of `+1/512`. Cancellation makes the signed mean alone an incomplete sensitivity measure. The mean absolute change is `7/512` crossings/probe; affected η-bin means in this small control subset change by as much as **0.2 crossings**. These are control-sample observations, not error bounds for all 8192 nominal probes.

The other controls are consistent with the overview’s scope:

- Reducing maximum step from 50 to 25 mm changes no per-system counts in 512 paired probes at each momentum.
- Refined-map counts are unchanged in the 10/100 GeV controls.
- Independent-seed full-tracker means differ by approximately **0.92, 0.03 and 0.02 combined standard errors** at 1/10/100 GeV respectively.

The wording in `docs/validation/tracker-propagation/README.md` correctly distinguishes sensitive planes from hits/stations and sampling errors from field/model uncertainty. It avoids claiming tracking performance or momentum-independent efficiency. Precision acceptance differences would require stronger map convergence, more control statistics and paired-difference uncertainty treatment.

Actual checks used `git show` for pinned evidence and the isolated `software/build/unrooted-venv/bin/python -I` for gzip/CSV analysis, hashes, NumPy calculations and ROOT/unrooted inspection. I also visually inspected the hash-matched overview PNG. No native runtime was activated, no simulation was rerun, and no files were changed. Execution revisions and installed binary provenance remain distinct from the enclosing review commit, as documented.
